reputation_system._reputation_gain_scaling_note: Round-4 REDESIGN (2026-07-25, replaces the round-3 damper): reputation moved from a 0-100 scale to a 0-700 scale so the goalposts stretch instead of the gains shrinking — flagship playlists now open at 510 ('last year should open 500+'). reputation_gain_scaling is now an AMPLIFIER (x3) applied to EVERY reputation delta, GAINS AND LOSSES ALIKE, via shared/utils/reputationScaling.scaleReputationGain (chart milestones, press coverage, PR-push/digital-ads, meeting immediate + delayed effects, the flop sink). Authored content values stay small (+1..+6); applied deltas are authored x3, and the choice-badge preview shows the SAME x3 value, so what the player is promised is exactly what lands. Trajectory anchor: undamped 0-100 pace was ~4.75 rep/week; x3 with authored 3/7 chart bonuses gives ~13/week -> flagship 510 lands ~week 40 of 52. Keep this value in lockstep with DEFAULT_REPUTATION_GAIN_SCALING in shared/utils/reputationScaling.ts (tripwire-tested).
reputation_system._flop_artist_mood_penalty_note: Volatility-economy slice 2: a flop doesn't just cost the label reputation (flop_penalty) — it wounds the release artist's morale. Applied ONCE, alongside the flop reputation sink (same once-only flag, same deterministic gate), to summary.artistChanges[release.artistId].mood; clamped 0-100 downstream. Signed value (negative = a drop). Zero RNG. Round-2 tuning (2026-07-12): flop_penalty 5 -> 8, flop_artist_mood_penalty -8 -> -12.

creative_capital_milestones._note: PENDING-DECISIONS #9 (2026-07-12): milestone-sourced Creative Capital — a small trickle from chart milestones so CC income isn't gated on one cco meeting choice. Fires via GameEngine.applyChartMilestoneBonuses on the SAME once-per-song flags as hit_single_bonus/number_one_bonus: cc_top10_bonus the week a song FIRST enters the top 10, cc_number_one_bonus the week it FIRST hits No. 1. NO-STACK: a #1 debut (both milestones same week) grants max(cc_top10_bonus, cc_number_one_bonus), not the sum — unlike the reputation bonuses, which stack. Not scaled by reputation_gain_scaling. No upper CC cap exists in the engine (floor 0 only).

weekly_meeting_selection._relevance_weight_note: Volatility-economy slice 4: raised 2.0 -> 3.0 so recently-relevant meetings surface more strongly (playtest: meeting relevance was too subtle to notice). Recency window unchanged.

artist_state_thresholds._note: Engine-verbs M16: thresholds for the per-artist-state requires tags (any_artist_low_mood / any_artist_high_popularity / any_artist_low_energy). Comparator is encoded in the knob name: _lt = strictly below, _gte = at or above.
